info.title: CLC Core API
info.description: HTTP API of the CLC Core service for accounts, vouchers, pools, catalogs and gasless transactions.

tags.name: Auth endpoints
tags.description: Sign-in with Ethereum, passkeys, sessions and the profile of the caller.

tags.name: Relayer
tags.description: Gasless batches that a user signs and the relayer sends.

tags.name: Contracts, tracking and system
tags.description: Deploy and upgrade contracts, track jobs and read system data.

tags.name: Vouchers and offerings
tags.description: Public market reads and the write routes for vouchers, reviews and offerings.

tags.name: Pools
tags.description: Pool reads and pool profile writes.

tags.name: Curated catalogs
tags.description: Catalogs that a user makes from pools and vouchers.

tags.name: Posts
tags.description: Field reports and their moderation.

tags.name: Lookups and shared vocabulary
tags.description: Tags, units, name checks and recipient lookups.

tags.name: Account data
tags.description: Token balances, transfers and activity of an account.

tags.name: Pretium
tags.description: Cash-in and cash-out routes that proxy the Pretium Ramp service.

tags.name: Current user
tags.description: Data that belongs to the signed-in user.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Superadmin routes for users, catalogs, moderation and statistics.

post.summary: Get a sign-in nonce
post.description: Creates a one-time nonce for a SIWE message. The route reads no request body. Access: Public.

post.summary: Register a user and sign in
post.description: Creates a user with the status 'APPROVED' and the role 'USER'. The response sets the session cookie. The caller does not need to call 'POST /auth/signin' after sign-up. Access: Public.

email.description: Must be a valid email. The server stores it in lower case.

400.description: E02: The body is not valid JSON. E04: A field fails validation. E04: The signature is not valid, the signer does not match line 2, or the nonce is not valid or is expired.

409.description: E16: The address is already linked to a user. Use POST /auth/signin instead. E17: The email is already linked to another user. The address is not registered. E16 or E17: Another request registered the same address or email at the same time. The code follows the constraint that failed.

post.summary: Sign in a registered user
post.description: Signs in a registered user. The response sets the session cookie. Access: Public.

400.description: E02: The body is not valid JSON. E04: A field is missing, the signature is not valid, the signer does not match line 2, or the nonce is not valid or is expired.

403.description: E10: The user status is PENDING or REJECTED.

404.description: E03: The address is not registered. Call POST /auth/signup first.

post.summary: Clear the session cookie
post.description: Clears the session cookie. The route does not read a body. The route succeeds when the caller has no session. The server keeps no token blocklist. A copy of the token stays valid until it expires. Access: Public.

post.summary: Sign in with a passkey
post.description: Signs in with a passkey. The request does not need a SIWE message. The assertion is the proof. The response sets the session cookie. Access: Public.

credentialId.description: The credential ID that the wallet registered.

authenticatorData.description: Base64url. Padded and unpadded forms work. At least 37 bytes after decoding.

clientDataJSON.description: Base64url. The type must be 'webauthn.get'. The origin must be on the allowed origin list.

400.description: E02 or E04: The body is not valid JSON, or a field is missing.

401.description: E15: The assertion is not valid. The challenge can be unknown, expired or used. The origin can be wrong. The signature can be wrong.

403.description: E10: The user status is PENDING or REJECTED.

404.description: E07: No active credential has this credentialId. E03: The credential address has no user.

get.summary: Return the session of the caller
get.description: Returns the session of the caller. This response does not use the standard envelope. Access: Public. The route reads the '__clc_auth' cookie. It ignores the 'Authorization' header.

200.description: The caller has a valid session. This response does not use the standard envelope.

address.description: Account address in EIP-55 checksum form.

204.description: The cookie is missing or is not valid. The response has no body.

get.summary: List the passkeys of the session account
get.description: Lists the passkeys that are mapped to the account of the session. The server reads only stored data. It does not read the chain. The order is newest first. Access: User session. The route reads the '__clc_auth' cookie. A service token does not work.

trackingId.description: Set only while 'state' is 'pending'. Use it with 'GET /api/v2/relayer/track/:trackingId'.

401.description: E06: The cookie is missing, or is not valid, or has no valid address.

post.summary: Get a sign-in nonce
post.description: Creates a one-time nonce for a SIWE message. The route reads no request body. It does the same as POST /auth/nonce. Access: Public.

post.summary: Sign in, or register and sign in
post.description: Signs in a user and registers the user if the address is new. Use this route for wallet SDKs. The request has the same fields as POST /auth/signin. A new address creates a user with the status APPROVED, the role USER and an empty name. The caller can set real values with POST /auth/profile. This route is the only sign-in route that returns the token in the body. The response also sets the session cookie. Access: Public.

400.description: E02: The body is not valid JSON. E04: A field is missing. E04: The nonce is not valid or is expired.

401.description: E04: The signature is not valid, or the signer does not match line 2.

403.description: E10: The user status is PENDING or REJECTED.

get.summary: Get the profile of the caller
get.description: Returns the profile of the signed-in user. The address comes from the session. Access: User session. A service token returns '403' with 'E10'. A caller without a valid credential gets '401' with 'E06'.

401.description: E06: The credential is missing or not valid.

403.description: E10: The caller uses a service token.

404.description: E03: the user does not exist.

post.summary: Save the profile of the caller
post.description: Saves the profile and returns the saved values. The response has the same fields as GET /auth/profile except createdAt. Access: User session. A service token returns '403' with 'E10'. A caller without a valid credential gets '401' with 'E06'.

name.description: Maximum 80 characters. Omitted sets an empty name.

email.description: Must be a valid email. Omitted or empty clears the email.

phone.description: Omitted or empty clears the phone.

country.description: Exactly 2 characters if sent. Omitted sets an empty value.

username.description: 1 to 80 characters after trimming. The server applies Unicode NFC. Omitted keeps the current value.

preferredCurrency.description: Maximum 32 characters. Omitted keeps the value.

bio.description: Maximum 500 characters. Omitted keeps the value. An empty string clears it.

website.description: Must be an 'http' or 'https' URL, or an empty string. Omitted keeps the value. An empty string clears it.

locationName.description: Maximum 200 characters. Must not be blank. Omitted keeps the value.

avatarUrl.description: Must be an 'http' or 'https' URL. Omitted keeps the value.

401.description: E06: The credential is missing or not valid.

403.description: E10: The caller uses a service token.

404.description: E03: The user does not exist.

409.description: E17: The email is linked to another user. E18: The phone is linked to another user. E16: The username is already in use.

post.summary: Get the session token for the image service
post.description: Returns the session token of the caller so that the caller can send it to the image storage service. The storage service reads only an 'Authorization' header. A browser script cannot read the 'HttpOnly' cookie. The route does not read a body. The route returns the same token that authenticated the request. It does not make a new token. Two calls with the same session return the same 'token' and 'expiresAt'. The response has the header 'Cache-Control: no-store'. Access: User session. A service token returns '403' with 'E10'.

401.description: E06: The caller has no valid credential. E06: The credential is not a user token that the route can read. E06: The credential is missing or not valid.

403.description: E10: The caller uses a service token. E10:.

get.summary: Return active vouchers that have complete coordinates
get.description: Returns active vouchers that have complete coordinates. The route supports a map viewport, search, tag filters and an owner filter. Access: Public. A user session is needed when 'nearby=true'.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Maximum is '500'. '0' or a larger value becomes '500'.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: 'minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat'. Four finite numbers. Longitude from -180 to 180, latitude from -90 to 90, and each minimum not above its maximum. A box cannot cross the antimeridian. Split the viewport into two requests in that case. An invalid value returns '400' 'E04'.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: A hex address. The server compares it with the voucher owner and ignores case. An invalid address returns '400' 'E04'.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The server trims the value and collapses inner spaces. The length must be 2 to 64 characters. An empty value means no search. A value of 2 characters matches a prefix. A longer value matches a substring. The match is case-insensitive. The characters '%', '_' and '\' match themselves.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tag values. Repeat the parameter or use commas. At most 12 distinct values. The server trims, deduplicates and sorts the values. Tag values are case-sensitive.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Value for Go 'ParseBool', for example 'true' or 'false'. The server computes tag facets on the first page only.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Pool references in the form 'chainId:address'. Repeat the parameter or use commas. At most 100 distinct references. The chain ID must be a positive integer. A voucher matches when at least one selected pool allows it.

name.description: The display name, or the contract name when no display name is set.

markerIcon.description: The marker the owner chose. 'null' means automatic.

markerColor.description: The marker the owner chose. 'null' means automatic.

vouchers.description: Voucher summaries. Empty array when none.

400.description: E02: perPage, next or cursor is not valid. E04: bbox, owner, a search parameter or a pools reference is not valid. E04: nearby=true and the caller has no saved location.

401.description: E06: nearby=true and the request has no valid session.

403.description: E10: nearby=true and the caller uses a service token.

429.description: E11: The rate limit is exceeded.

get.description: Returns the detail of one active voucher. Access: Public.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A hex address. The lookup ignores case.

400.description: E04: address is not a valid hex address.

404.description: E07: The voucher does not exist or is retired. The two cases give the same response.

get.description: Returns the available offerings of one active voucher. The order is descending 'id'. Access: Public.

parameters.name: address

parameters.name: perPage

post.summary: Create an offering for a voucher
post.description: Creates an offering for a voucher. The server sets the seller. The seller is the voucher owner. When the voucher has no owner, only a superadmin can create the offering, and the seller is that superadmin. Access: User session. The caller must be the voucher owner or a superadmin.

commodityName.description: The server trims it. At most 120 characters.

description.description: The server trims it. At most 2000 characters.

unit.description: The server trims it. At most 32 characters. A value that is not in the unit list becomes a new custom unit.

price.description: Plain decimal text, for example '5' or '12.50'. No sign, no exponent and no separator. The value must be above zero. At most 64 characters.

imageUrl.description: An 'http' or 'https' URL. An empty string or 'null' means no image.

400.description: E02: The body is not valid JSON. E04: address is not valid, or a body field is outside the rules.

401.description: E06: No valid session. E06: The credential is missing or not valid.

403.description: E10: The caller uses a service token, or is not the owner or a superadmin. E10: The caller uses a service token.

404.description: E03: The voucher does not exist.

409.description: E16: The voucher is retired.

429.description: E11: The caller reached the offer limit of the account. The result has resource, used and limit. A superadmin has no limit.

get.description: Returns one available offering of an active voucher. Access: Public.

404.description: E03: The offering does not exist, is unlisted, belongs to another voucher, or its voucher is retired.

put.description: Replaces the product fields of an offering. The body is the same as for 'POST /api/v2/vouchers/:address/offerings'. Every field is written. A request without 'imageUrl' removes the image. There is no partial update. Access: User session. The caller must be the voucher owner or a superadmin.

unit.description: The server trims it. At most 32 characters. A value that is not in the unit list becomes a new custom unit.

price.description: Plain decimal text, for example '5' or '12.50'. No sign, no exponent and no separator. The value must be above zero. At most 64 characters.

imageUrl.description: An 'http' or 'https' URL. An empty string or 'null' means no image.

delete.description: Unlists an offering. The server keeps the row and sets 'available' to 'false'. The public routes no longer return it. The server does not delete the stored image. Access: User session. The caller must be the voucher owner or a superadmin.

get.summary: Return the visible reviews of a voucher, newest first
get.description: Returns the visible reviews of a voucher, newest first. Each page has at most 20 reviews. Access: Public.

parameters.name: stars
parameters.description: From 1 to 5. The filter applies to the list only. 'counts', 'total' and 'average' cover all visible reviews.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: A review 'id'. Returns reviews with a lower 'id'. Use the 'next' value of the previous response.

counts.description: The number of reviews for each star value. The keys are '"1"' to '"5"'.

next.description: The 'before' value for the next page.

400.description: E04: address is not a valid hex address. stars is not an integer from 1 to 5, or before is not a valid number.

404.description: The voucher does not exist.

429.description: E11: The rate limit is exceeded.

get.summary: Return available offerings of active vouchers
get.description: Returns available offerings of active vouchers. An offering must have a location. The location is the offering location, or the voucher location when the offering has none. The order is newest first, or nearest first with 'nearby=true'. Access: Public. A user session is needed when 'nearby=true'.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches the offering name, the offering description, the voucher name, the voucher symbol and the offering tags.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tag values. Repeat the parameter or use commas. At most 12 distinct values. The server trims, deduplicates and sorts the values. Tag values are case-sensitive.

parameters.name: facets

parameters.name: pools

429.description: E11: The rate limit is exceeded.

get.summary: List offerings, vouchers, pools and catalogs together
get.description: Returns one mixed list of offerings, vouchers, pools and curated catalogs. The server does the ranking and the paging in one query. Every response has 'Cache-Control: no-store'. Access: Public. A user session is needed when 'nearby=true'.

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Values 'catalog', 'offering', 'pool' and 'voucher'. Repeat the parameter or use commas. The server ignores case and empty items. Another value returns '400' 'E04'.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches the name, symbol, description, tags and related names of a row.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tag values. Repeat the parameter or use commas. At most 12 distinct values. The server trims, deduplicates and sorts the values. Tag values are case-sensitive.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Value for Go 'ParseBool', for example 'true' or 'false'. The server computes tag facets on the first page only.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Pool references in the form 'chainId:address'. Repeat the parameter or use commas. At most 100 distinct references. The chain ID must be a positive integer. A voucher matches when at least one selected pool allows it.

id.description: ID in the table of the kind.

address.description: The voucher address for an offering. 'null' for a catalog.

voucherCount.description: For a pool row and a catalog row.

400.description: E04: perPage, kinds, a search parameter or a pools reference is not valid. E04: nearby=true and the caller has no saved location.

403.description: E10: nearby=true and the caller uses a service token.

429.description: E11: The rate limit is exceeded.

get.summary: Return a page of catalogs
get.description: Returns a page of catalogs. The default order is newest first ('id' descending). With 'nearby=true', the order is nearest first, then 'id' ascending. A request with 'nearby=true' and no valid session returns '401 E06'. A request with 'nearby=true' and a service token returns '403 E10'. A caller without a saved profile location gets '400 E04' with the description 'a valid saved profile location is required'. Access: Public. With 'nearby=true', a user session is required.

parameters.name: nearby
parameters.description: Use the saved profile location of the caller. Only catalogs within 1000 km are returned. The response is not cached.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text. Whitespace is trimmed and repeated spaces become one space. The length must be 2 to 64 characters. The search is not case-sensitive. It matches 'name', 'locationName', and 'description'. A term of 2 characters matches the start of the text. A longer term matches any part of the text.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tag filter. Repeat the parameter or use a comma-separated list. At most 12 distinct values. Each value must exist in the tag vocabulary. The comparison is exact.

parameters.name: tagMatch
parameters.description: A catalog must have any of the tags, or all of the tags.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Pool filter. Repeat the parameter or use a comma-separated list of 'chainId:address' values. At most 100 distinct values. A catalog matches when it contains one of the pools, or contains a voucher that one of the pools allows.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: With 'true' on the first page, add 'tagFacets' to the response.
